briefing.geography: Cooling lava-vein bands divide the dry shore between the last warm vent and a cooled titan machine older than the Combine.
goals: Keep the last warm vent alight through at least one full squall.
Survive through wave 12 with warmth remaining to secure the shore.
Pan gold and return to the vent to stoke it before its warmth runs out.
rules: During a squall, the vent loses 4 warmth each second. If it reaches zero, the claim is lost.
Within 4 paces of the vent, Stoke spends 15 gold to restore 40 warmth.
The shore has no river or water source; gather gold from the seams along the western approach.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.

data.consequence: the last warm vent holds 100 warmth and loses 4 a second for as long as a Static squall blows, and nothing else on this map takes warmth from it. STOKE inside 4 of the last-warm-vent spends 15 gold for 40 warmth. A vent that reaches zero ends the run there and then; a claim cannot be secured at any wave unless the vent is still alight and has ridden out at least 1 whole squall.

a Static squall crosses the whole shore on a fixed cycle: 60s calm, an 8s telegraph as the edges pale, 25s of squall, an 8s recover. The browser desaturates and ducks the mix while it blows. The squall is the only time the vent loses warmth, and while it blows twice the usual share of the field walks at the vent instead of at you.

data.consequence: the last warm vent holds 100 warmth and loses 4 a second for as long as a Static squall blows, and nothing else on this map takes warmth from it. STOKE inside 4 of the last-warm-vent spends 15 gold for 40 warmth. A vent that reaches zero ends the run there and then; a claim cannot be secured at any wave unless the vent is still alight and has ridden out at least 1 whole squall.

a Static squall crosses the whole shore on a fixed cycle: 60s calm, an 8s telegraph as the edges pale, 25s of squall, an 8s recover. The browser desaturates and ducks the mix while it blows. The squall is the only time the vent loses warmth, and while it blows twice the usual share of the field walks at the vent instead of at you.
